parameter_reviews.name: erm.k_on

declaration.source: PI signature 2026-09-11 00:35 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-1x-erm-kon-reach §2, §6). Sourced as the DATASET pair with erm.k_off0 = 1.3/s (PI decision J): every in-cell observation needs occupancy 0.75-0.9 — Coscoy 2002 PNAS 99:12813 (10.1073/pnas.192084599) two-photon FRAP, 25 % of membrane ezrin exchanging on tau = 5.7 s, rest on 1-2 min; Alert 2015 rho_b*/rho_0 ~ 0.9; Diz-Munoz 2010 density — and with k_off0 1.3 that occupancy is k_on*P ~ 4-12/s (0.88 at 10). Only k_on*P(reach) is identifiable (laws/erm_kinetics). The former '1e4/s (Alert 2015)' is DELETED: Alert's Table 1 takes k_on 1e4 and k_off0 10 from Rognoni 2012 PNAS (10.1073/pnas.1211274109), a FILAMIN Ig20-21 measurement, and fits only chi = k_off/k_on. STATED RESIDUAL: this pair relaxes to occupancy in ~90 ms, while ezrin re-covers a bare bleb membrane in ~5 s (Charras 2006 JCB 175:477, 10.1083/jcb.200602085: ezrin precedes actin by 4.9 +/- 3 s) — a bleb-healing row is ~50x too fast with this pair; the in-cell pair (k_on ~0.2, k_off ~0.03-0.2) needs a re-ratification of k_off0 = a two-row PI decision, OPEN. parameter_reviews.name: erm.reach

declaration.source: PI signature 2026-09-11 00:35 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-1x-erm-kon-reach §3, §6). A pairing filter on the node lattice, not a bond length: the native cortex has 4.59 M nodes in a 0.2 um shell (~0.031 um apart) with its edge at depth 0.018-0.020 um, so a membrane vertex's nearest cortex NODE is at median 0.034 um and the former 0.025 paired 8-11 % of vertices (RESULT-2026-09-10-fixed-build-first-row; Monte-Carlo erm_reach_coverage.json: 0.045 -> 92 %, 0.050 -> 98 %). Inside the molecule: ERM monomer span 10-50 nm, live membrane-cortex boundary gap <10 / <=20 nm (Clausen ... Fritzsche, Eggeling 2017 J Phys D 50:064002, 10.1088/1361-6463/aa52a1, STED on live Jurkat). Every pair RESTS at its built distance (bonds.attach; occupy_at_build a693ab1f) so no initial-load cap is needed — Bell at erm.k 4600 and x_beta 0.7 nm gives k_off(115 pN) ~ 2e8/s, a pair rested at r0 with 25 nm of stretch would die in one step. erm.r0 = 0.020 is the unstressed span. Replaces PI-GAP card E4

source_cards.title: Braunger 2014: rupture-fit parameters and separately estimated stiffness

registered_source_evidence_rows.short_source: Braunger J, Brückner BR, Nehls S, Pietuch A, Gerke V, Mey I, Janshoff A, Steinem C. Phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate alters the number of attachment sites between ezrin and actin filaments: a colloidal probe study. J Biol Chem. 2014;289(14):9833-9843.
registered_source_evidence_rows.notes: Single ezrin–F-actin bond stiffness k_b = 4.6 pN/nm (N≈1 bond) via colloidal-probe AFM; as-measured system stiffness k_sys = 2.2 pN/nm (cantilever k_c≈40 pN/nm in series). Unbinding force ≈50 pN (WT 50 / T567D 58 / T567A 43 pN); k_off = 1.3 s⁻¹; barrier width 0.7 nm. Perpendicular detachment geometry. Source for k_erm (KB-3.B1.6). DOI verified via PubMed PMID 24500715 / PMC3975028.

source_audit_rows.note: CrossRef: braunger 2014 — Phosphatidylinositol 4,5-Bisphosphate Alters the Number of Attachment

source_cards.primary_anchor: Experimental Procedures; Figs.7–8; Discussion stiffness analysis

conditions.construct: Recombinant N-His6 ezrin; force-rate fit uses T567D on Ni-NTA AFM tip (~30 nm radius), F-actin on charged gold. Ezrin species not established from accessed expression description.
conditions.buffer: 20 mM Tris-HCl pH7.4, 50 mM KCl, 0.2 mM MgCl2, 0.1 mM EDTA/NaN3; 200 pN contact load, 1 s dwell.

source_cards.observational_unit: Rupture forces versus loading rate; force-curve stiffness distribution.
source_cards.finding: Fig.8 Evans–Ritchie fit yields off-rate 1.3/s and barrier width 0.7 nm. Discussion obtains 4.6 pN/nm from stiffness mean/variance under a Poisson bond-number estimate (~1), with a stiff-transducer approximation.
source_cards.limits: The stiffness estimate is a separate analysis, not a third parameter of the same force-rate fit. No association rate measured; no temperature conversion to 310 K established.
source_cards.reported_uncertainty: Fig.8: 28 independent experiments; Fig.7: 5. No uncertainty interval located for 1.3/s, 0.7 nm or 4.6 pN/nm.

source_cards.title: Diz-Muñoz 2010: active-link density inferred from dynamic tethers
source_cards.primary_anchor: Fig.1H; Fig.S2G; Table S1; Materials and Methods dynamic tether model

conditions.cell_state: Isolated zebrafish prechordal-plate progenitors; control and ERM-perturbed conditions, not MCF7.
conditions.assay: ConA AFM tethers, 100 pN contact, 0–0.6 s dwell, 1–50 um/s pulling; DMEM/F12, within 1 h of seeding.
conditions.temperature: AFM temperature not located; 28 C belongs to a different imaging protocol.
conditions.model_inputs: Lipid-permeation regime; fixed bending rigidity 2.9e-19 N m, membrane viscosity 1.5e-7 Pa m s, and lipid tension 2.5 uN/m from LatA.

source_cards.observational_unit: Dynamic tether-force observations; fitted active crosslinkers per membrane area.
source_cards.finding: Approximate 600/um² and 41 nm spacing describe one inferred density, not two independent measurements. Inverse-area spacing convention gives 1/(0.041 um)^2 ≈595/um². Static control median is 32 pN (114 tethers/56 cells); 25 pN belongs to a distinct curve-selection comparison.
source_cards.limits: The estimate depends on fixed mechanical inputs. Active bound-link density does not directly equal allocated ERM capacity. Same-cell AFM/FRAP pairing and MCF7 transfer not established; universal “only measured density” claim not verified.
source_cards.reported_uncertainty: Fig.1H/S2G uncertainty propagated from fit, not population SD. Table S1 separates tether and cell counts; repeated tethers are not independent cells.

source_cards.title: Coscoy 2002: ezrin FRAP fractions and nonunique short-time fit
source_cards.primary_anchor: Table1; Fig.4e; Results restricted recovery and time-lapse FRAP

conditions.cell_state: Confluent LLC-PK1 epithelial microvilli, tagged ezrin constructs.
conditions.assay: Local two-photon bleach (~1 um volume), 50 ms bleach and 10 s recovery; separate time-lapse protocol uses a 5x20 um band and 7 s sampling.

source_cards.observational_unit: Fluorescence recovery fraction and time scale, with cytoplasmic/membrane-pool denominators.
source_cards.finding: WT fast/slow pools are approximately 30%/70% of total signal. Under the reaction-limited interpretation, about 25% of the membrane pool exchanges on the short scale. Fig.4e reaction-fit tau=5.7 s and slow-diffusion fit D≈0.1 um²/s both describe the record. Separate slow recovery has typical half-time 1–2 min.
source_cards.limits: Exchanging fraction is not the mechanically occupied fraction. A FRAP tau is not automatically microscopic k_off or 1/(k_on+k_off); diffusion, pool exchange and reporter geometry differ. The paper does not identify current k_on=10/s.
source_cards.reported_uncertainty: Fig.4 intensity curves use SEM; WT n=117 and internally tagged n=118 measurements. No tau=5.7 s confidence interval located.

source_cards.title: Charras 2006: ezrin-to-actin arrival delay is not whole bleb healing
source_cards.primary_anchor: Fig.5D and caption; kinetics of cortex reassembly; Imaging methods

conditions.cell_state: Blebbing filamin-deficient human melanoma M2 cells, actin/ezrin reporters.
conditions.assay: Detectable fluorescence arrival relative to actin time zero, images every 1 s for 120 s; at most 5 blebs/cell and at least 5 cells per protein.

source_cards.observational_unit: Between-reporter arrival delay per bleb, not an individual binding event.
source_cards.finding: Ezrin appears 4.87±3 s before actin (23 blebs); reported error is SD. Assembly of the complete contractile cortex is described on an approximately 30 s scale.
source_cards.limits: The 4.87 s delay does not measure recovery of bare membrane, a first-order ERM relaxation time, or a microscopic association/off-rate. It cannot by itself establish a “50x too fast” kinetic mismatch.
source_cards.reported_uncertainty: 4.87±3 s is mean±SD over n=23 blebs, not 23 independent cells.

source_cards.title: Alert 2015: conditional adhesion theory and borrowed kinetic inputs
source_cards.primary_anchor: Eqs.2–5; Table1; micropipette analysis and Discussion

conditions.system: Theoretical membrane–cortex adhesion model; comparison to published Dictyostelium micropipette perturbations.
conditions.assumptions: Flat immobile cortex, uniform normal stress, constant association rate and force-dependent dissociation; model-specific stationary solutions.

source_cards.observational_unit: Available density rho0, bound density rhob, rate ratio chi=k_off/k_on, and critical normal stress.
source_cards.finding: Table1 assigns k_on=1e4/s and k_off0=10/s to reference26 (Rognoni). Critical bound fraction ~0.9 and force/link ~16–18 pN follow conditional model choices. Estimated critical stress constrains chi under those choices.
source_cards.limits: Critical occupancy is not measured steady occupancy in MCF7. These are borrowed theory inputs, not an ezrin on/off measurement. The exact Rognoni rate branch behind the rounded pair remains unresolved.

document_anchors.description: Table1 model estimates including on/off entries

source_cards.reported_uncertainty: No empirical covariance for current ERM rows. Table1 choices are stated as condition dependent; model-derived quantities are not population uncertainty.

source_cards.title: Rognoni 2012: tethered filamin kinetics have a different denominator
source_cards.primary_anchor: Figs.2C,3C,4D; Results peptide competition and autoinhibition

conditions.construct: Human filamin A domain21 or20–21 with tethered GPIb-alpha, beta7-integrin or migfilin peptides; dual optical trap, 180 nm DNA handles, 1 um beads.
conditions.force_definition: Fixed trap separation; reported force bias averages forces in open and closed states.

source_cards.observational_unit: Tethered peptide opening/closing per second versus solution-association coefficient per uM per second.
source_cards.finding: For tethered GPIb-alpha, zero-force fits give closing 34000/s and opening 1.9/s; fast closing reflects effective local concentration. Free-peptide competition gives 3.7/(uM s) and 1.8/s. Separate domain autoinhibition fit has half-opening force 3.9 pN.
source_cards.limits: None is an ezrin–actin rate. Main text does not locate Alert’s 1e4/10 pair as one exact fit; SI tables were not acquired, so a specific filamin branch attribution remains unresolved.
source_cards.reported_uncertainty: No uncertainty for these rate numbers was recovered from main text; do not infer variance from differing constructs or free/tethered values.

conditions.construct: FNIII7–10 against recombinant alpha5beta1-Fc or headpiece; native human vascular smooth-muscle integrin reconstituted in a bilayer as control.
conditions.cation_conditions: 1 mM Ca +1 mM Mg; 2 mM Mg +2 mM EGTA; or2 mM Mn, plus antibody variants.
conditions.assay: AFM force-clamp; <20% adhesion frequency, 0.5 s contact, 200 nm/s retraction, force bins over5–70 pN.
conditions.temperature: Force-clamp temperature not located; preparation temperatures are not transferred.

source_cards.observational_unit: Bond lifetime conditional on clamped force, cations, construct and capture linkage.
source_cards.finding: For full extracellular alpha5beta1-Fc, lifetimes increase over10–30 pN. At >30 pN in Mg/EGTA or Mn, the Fc–GG7 capture linkage can limit lifetime; the Ca/Mg branch supports a distinct high-force interpretation. For the truncated headpiece, the capture linkage limits the measured serial-bond lifetime above25 pN in all three cation conditions.
source_cards.limits: This is not a direct measurement of a complete integrin–talin–actin clutch, its2 pN force scale, or k_on0.3/s. Multiple lifetime populations and capture controls constrain interpretation. Frozen citation key says Nature, but DOI/article are JCB; raw registry retained.

source_cards.observational_unit: Membrane-to-cortex fluorescence-peak distance versus inferred cortex outer-boundary gap.
source_cards.finding: Peak distances near50±15 and120±40 nm use different geometry from the inferred boundary gap (<10 or at most20 nm). The10–50 nm ERM monomer span is cited structural context, not measured by this STED experiment.
source_cards.limits: A boundary gap does not directly measure unstressed molecular length or node capture reach. Frozen erm.r0 is a geometry input; actual ERM relation rest is built separation. Current .045 um reach is a numerical pairing filter.
source_cards.reported_uncertainty: Peak-distance spreads are reported standard deviations; finite PSF/deconvolution assumptions remain. Do not attach those SDs to20 nm or a microscopic rest-length prior.

relations.statement: Braunger off-rate/barrier width share a loading-rate fit; stiffness comes from another inference. The frozen force scale kBT/x_beta changes with temperature without establishing temperature transfer of off-rate.
assumptions: Same construct, loading geometry and fit convention are required; no unreported covariance is reconstructed.

relations.statement: Diz active-link density is model inferred. Frozen areal_density allocates potential owners; actual built bound count also depends on reach, candidate geometry and stationary-state draw. Density and spacing are one inferred quantity.
assumptions: Density×area applies only to the correct membrane area denominator. Build count is capped at node count. No native count or reachable fraction was measured in this pass.

relations.statement: FRAP recovery and ezrin-before-actin delay do not directly identify current two-state rates. In a closed constant-rate two-state system only, stationary occupancy would be on/(on+off) and relaxation rate on+off.
assumptions: Identical tracked states and populations, fixed rates, zero load, no diffusion/recruitment or changing geometry, and an appropriate observation/error model are prerequisites. Neither paper establishes them for frozen ERM.

relations.statement: Alert borrows filamin-associated kinetics and predicts critical occupancy conditional on a membrane-adhesion model. No automatic filamin→ezrin rate or critical→ordinary occupancy transfer follows.
assumptions: Exact Rognoni branch for the rounded1e4/10 pair remains unresolved without SI. Tethered first-order closure and free-solution association have different denominators.

relations.statement: Clausen boundary-gap inference supplies geometry context. Frozen erm.r0 sets cortex location, while ERM pairs rest at their own built separation and reach filters eligible node pairs.
assumptions: Imaging peak/boundary definitions, labeling, PSF, cell type and mesh geometry must be aligned; no measured microscopic rest-length distribution is recovered.

relations.statement: Count=density×adhesion area is dimensional bookkeeping only after receptor identity, active fraction and area denominator are fixed. Model clutch count is not a measured surface integrin census.
assumptions: Need heterodimer/state, local basal adhesion area versus whole-cell membrane area, bound/available fraction and molecules per effective clutch. None is supplied by the16-row scope.

relations.statement: Author thesis and later model tables differ; direct alpha5beta1 lifetime data do not identify the entire clutch linkage parameters. Current numeric matches do not establish a shared fit or covariance.
assumptions: Resolve original Science SI before choosing a version attribution. Align force signs, capture-bond limitations, cations and effective-linkage definition before any mechanistic comparison.

relations.statement: Sensor response up to8 pN supplies conditional force context, not uniform endogenous force, stiffness or census. Frozen linc.tension is an observer comparison; linc.areal_density sets only lamina_envelope population.
assumptions: Stiffness requires matched force-extension observations. Force-per-object/count transfer requires endogenous construct and load-path mapping. Observer target/median(k) is a hypothetical shortening diagnostic, not a measured extension.

source_code_anchors.interpretation: Two-state rates read erm.k_on/k_off0; force scale kBT/x_beta; no positive explicit rest length means as_built. Static declaration only.
ERM receives no fixed rest length. Both LINC relation kinds use linc.k.
ERM areal density allocates owner capacity, capped at membrane node count and weighted by represented area; not an observed bound-link count.
Build draws stationary states, applies node reach and partner admissibility, then marks only finite bound candidates alive; ERM rest is built separation. No native occupancy measured here.
erm.r0 shifts the cortex shell geometry, alongside membrane sagitta and half-thickness. It is not passed as ERM fixed bond rest length.
linc.areal_density samples lamina_envelope owners per envelope area, capped by lamina node count. linc_if instead selects the first node of each IF strand.
linc.tension is an axial-load comparison target. target/median(k) is a hypothetical shortening diagnostic, not imposed prestress or measured extension.
Frozen suspended specimen marks integrin engagement and clutch absent until a distinct adherent preparation; declaration is not proof of active relations.

source_quantities: conditional critical stress and bound fraction

limits: Bounded literature and static source review; no native run, source registration, model change, NN label or new parameter estimate.
Exact Science2008 SI and Rognoni2012 SI remain unavailable; version/rate-branch gaps are unresolved, not claimed false.
No current MCF7 ERM/link density, integrin census, LINC count or stiffness measurement was established.
No source-reported covariance is reconstructed. Source estimation groups describe source provenance only; all current fit memberships remain empty.
Historical snapshots remain immutable, including stale source-audit wording and broad earlier claims. Their preservation is not endorsement.
Direct Tinevez2009 reinspection and the specific cross-paper18 pN/link bridge are outside this bounded packet; Alert conditional force/link is not independent validation of that bridge.
next_source_work: Resolve the original Science2008 supplementary table and version-specific stiffness/on-rate attribution before any source correction proposal.
Acquire Rognoni SI with exact rate branch, construct, buffer and temperature before attributing Alert’s rounded pair to a particular domain transition.
Specify which observed ERM population should map to capacity versus reachable/active bound objects; distinguish endogenous activation, geometry and binding kinetics.
For any integrin count proposal, specify receptor heterodimer, membrane versus adhesion-area denominator and available/engaged fraction.
For LINC, choose the endogenous construct/load path and distinguish sensor calibration range from a force statistic; obtain paired extension or object census before stiffness/density inference.
